Our app is currently doing $50,000/week. 
This month we will wrap up at $150K MRR.

and thats just 1 of my businesses, I have have many others 

bringing in over $200k/mo in personal income.and all of these businesses are built on the back of claude.
Claude is literally my COO.

and yet 99% of people still use Claude like an assistant,
to help them with basic tasks.

at this point thats caveman behavior.

The reason i'm able to run so many 
6 figure/mo business at once

boils down to the precision in which I use Claude. 
and thats exactly what i will break down in this article
STEP 1: MCP MAXING

The first step to get above average results with Claude
Is to give claude access to useful MCPS:

MCP's are like super powers for Claude
For example, recently i tried re creating a very famous game

That has over 4 Billion downloads
I sent the same prompt to 2 agents

1 claude agent had access to 2 MCPS   
( higgsfield MCP for images + meshy AI for 3d models )

The other agent had no access to mcps.

The results speak for themselves.

the agent with access to MCP delivered exceptional results 
compared to the other agent.
SO WHICH MCPS SHOULD YOU GET?

Lets say you want to build a  SAAS that turns images into 3D models.
I'll send Claude a prompt like this:

My Claude code agent is connected to all of these MCPS by default:

→  Dribbble API to research visual direction
→ Higgsfield MCP for every image gen and video gen model
→ Blender MCP to make 3D assets for games
→ Vercel MCP to host the website
→ Resend API to send emails (login codes, receipts, everything)
→ Supabase MCP to spin up the database
→ GoDaddy MCP to manage DNS records

so now instead of wasting days setting 
everything up myself 

Claude handles it all.  

but even with all these super powers

you would still need to be sending 1 prompt at a time. 
because AI has a cap on how many tokens it can spend per prompt.

thats when the loops comes in.

CLAUDE LOOPS + MCPS = SUPER EFFICIENCY

Instead of prompting 1 prompt a time,
You can run this fun little command inside claude code 

/loop 

basically this makes claude automatically 
prompts itself over and over again for hours.

It writes the code, tests it, sees what broke, fixes it, tests again.
until it achieves the goal you set for it.

This is how I build all of my websites, apps and businesses:

→Claude Code 
→Opus 5
→Ultra think mode 
→/loop command
→ + a text file called TASKS.md 
which sets the goal that claude has to achieve
rules for a clean loop
→ Write TASKS.md like you are briefing a junior developer.
Vague goals = vague output.
→ Give each task one clear outcome.

“Deploy the app to Vercel”
not “Make the app better.”
You have to be extremely specific.
→ Put spending limits on every API key.

Claude will burn through your credits
if you let it.
→ Run the loop inside a sandboxed folder.
Never point /loop at your main repository.
→ Add a kill switch using a MAX_RUNTIME variable.
I usually cap mine at 12 hours.

If it still has not shipped by then,
something is probably wrong.

Now here is where loops and MCPs
get even crazier.
You do not have to run just one loop at a time.
You can run multiple loops in parallel.
Loop 1 builds the app.

Loop 2 generates 50 pieces of UGC
to promote the app.
For example:

I recently built a brand-new app
using a Claude loop.
And this is how it turned out:
then in parallel I ran another loop that made a bunch of different ads with Higgsfield MCP and it made me a bunch of professional UGC ads that i can now use to promote the app.

And all of this took 10 minutes of my attention, set the loops off 
And forgot about it, welcome to the future.
BUILDING SYSTEMS WITH CLAUDE:

We covered MCP maxxing
and loop maxxing with Claude.

But another way I abuse Claude
is by using it to build systems.
Most parts of a business can be automated.

The more you automate,
the more you can handle
without needing a massive team.
For example, I had Claude build a complete content system for my UGC team.
It includes:

→ Daily videos for creators to record
→ Scripts for every video
→ Step-by-step recording instructions
→ Tools that help them create better content
→ A full content calendar that keeps everything organized
Because of this system,

we are able to run a team of 20+ UGC creators
without needing managers or extra hands.
It is almost completely automated.

And that is just one of the hundreds of systems
I have integrated across all of my companies.
So ask yourself:

What part of my business am I still doing manually
that Claude could turn into a system?

Then run a /loop
and have Claude build the automation for you.
THE $1M OPPORTUNITY

Most people are still using Claude

to write emails, summarize documents,
and complete basic tasks.
But that is barely scratching the surface.

The real opportunity is using Claude
to build products, create content, automate operations,
and run entire parts of your business.
MCPs give Claude access to better tools.

Loops give Claude the ability
to keep working until the job is finished.

Systems turn that work
into something your business can use every day.

When you combine all three,
Claude stops being an assistant.
It becomes an operator.

That is how I am able to run multiple businesses
without needing a massive team
or spending every hour managing people.
And we are still extremely early.

So stop asking Claude
to help you complete random tasks.
Give it a real goal.
Connect it to the right tools.
Put it inside a loop.

And have it build a system
that continues creating value long after you close your laptop.

The people who understand this now
are going to have an unfair advantage
over everyone who still thinks AI is just a chatbot.

blocks.text: There is an app called 75HER pulling $200,000 a month right now, Go look at their TikTok videos, Every video looks like a real women sharing their before and after transformation.... yet none of those women are real.

Every creator in their UGC program is an AI character. 
This is only the beginning of the future

a new form of marketing is here, 
and this app is only proof of how powerful it already is.

Im this article I am going to break down exactly how 75HER does this, 
and how you copy the whole system for your app 

using Arcads MCP Step by step.
How the 75HER app makes $200k/mo

75HER is a women's fitness app built around the 75 Hard challenge.
but targeting only women, which is a great choice 

Considering women are some of the most impulsive buyers. 
which is part of the reason they are printing $200k/mo

Their whole content strategy is drastic before and afters of the women

before being fat 
after being ripped  

which is VERY easy to do with AI 
not only is this content strategy genius, but its also very profitable.

Real human UGC runs $15-25 per video 
AI UGC videos: $0.20 cents per video

so not only are they at $200k/mo their margins are probably insane. 
Since they don't have to spend that much money on marketing.
but enough yapping, let's break down their entire system right now:
so now that you've seen the system actually works, let me break down exactly how to build it yourself.
Step 1: Set up the MCP
With RCATS, it generates videos.
Here's how you set up the MCP so Claude can run it for you.
the MCP is just what lets Claude actually use RCATS for you. instead of you sitting there clicking through a dashboard, Claude talks to it directly and does the work.
you set it up once and you don't really have to touch it again.
Step 2: Talk to Claude
once the MCP is connected, you don't prompt a video tool anymore.
you just talk to Claude like you would a creative director.

you tell him what you want, he runs Arcads, and the videos comes back.
but before he can make anything, you need to give him a character to work with.
Step 3: Create your character

this is the part most people skip, 
and its exactly why their videos end up looking fake.

before you make any video you first need a reference 
for who your character actually is.
so you describe them to Claude, and you have to be insanely specific:

→ Age, ethnicity, hair color, skin tone
→ Lighting ( natural, gym lighting, golden hour )
→ Environment ( gym, kitchen, outdoor, bedroom )
→ Accessories ( water bottle, resistance band, airpods )
→ Vibe ( serious athlete, wellness girlie, biohacker, morning routine guy )

the best way is to start from a real human 
and send that to arcads then change it up with nano banana inside of arcads.

the before is the problem and the after is the result. 

that contrast is basically the whole hook, people stop 
scrolling for the transformation

generate a few and keep the 2-3 that look the most real.
example of before and after below
now you have a character thats real enough to build a whole account around.
Step 4: Make them move
a static image is only where you start.

now you need actual moving footage, and this is where most people overcomplicate it.

 they spend hours trying to prompt realistic motion, sending the longest prompts trying to get the girl to pose and it just looks un-natural

there's a much easier way.
Download a video from pinterest of someone posing 

send that video to Gemini and tell it to analyze every body movement
Ask it to give you a prompt to replicate those exact movements

then send the prompt to Claude + the start image 
and the arcads mcp will take care of the rest.
Super simple.
Step 5: Edit and add your CTA

Once you have both the before and after videos 
you can have claude literally stitch them together

What I personally did is I vibe coded myself a web editor 
That Claude can use and that way i can see how it works

That way I see what he is working on 
Then make sure to add a call to action to your videos in the caption

or in the comments 
similar to how the 75 her app does it
Step 6: Automate the whole pipeline with Claude

at this point you have a system thats repeatable, 
so now let's make the whole thing run without you.

since the MCP is connected,
Claude doesn't just make one video, he runs the entire pipeline.

he can now 
→ Make the before and after videos
→ Put them together
→ And edit elements on top

So all you have to do is post those videos and wait to go viral, 
Most of the virality will actually come from your characters

And the before and after format you chose to replicate
because there are multiple, just follow whats trending.

and to actually distribute the content you can do 1 of 2 things
1 You can do it manually by creating a few accounts on your phone. You can do up to five per phone and then buy a few phones and constantly be posting yourself.

2 you can do what we do, 

which is pay somebody $50 a week per account to post.

Basically, for $200 a month, we have them post 60 videos across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. 

It saves us a lot of time because, at scale, this can get pretty tedious, but that is what we do. 

We don't use any posting service except for YouTube because that can get you shadow banned pretty quickly
Step 7: Print views and scale your app
once your AI influencers start performing, if your CTA is good, you'll start seeing spikes in downloads and sales for your app.
at that point you take the influencer videos that already worked in organic, and you put them behind paid ads.
and thats how $200k/mo apps are born.

except now you have full control over the content, 
and you don't need to micro manage any influencers.
you are the influencer now, the orchestrator.
if you found this guide useful feel free to doomscroll my account, I share sauce on how to make money with apps every day.

blocks.text:
we automated an entire AI UGC studio with Claude + Higgsfield AI for context I make $1M+/yr across my apps and businesses. and very recently we scaled one of our apps to $720,000/yr and #22 on the appstore.

We did this with a combination of Meta ads, tiktok ads and UGC. 

the most effective being UGC, however.. UGC can get quite expensive at scale, think about it 

$15 per video  x 2 videos per day
$30 per creator/day * 7 days in the week

its $210/week or $900/mo 
without counting the virality bonuses.

if our team is 30 creators we are looking to spend
$27,000/mo just base on creators.

and with our campaign generating over many millions of views/mo we 
of course have creators hitting bonuses quite often.

this is not unprofitable for us at all. 
we see great margins from our UGC efforts.

the only problem is.. that to expand your team from 10  to 20 creators for example it gets complicated.

instead of just hiring 10 more people

you end up having to hire 30 more, then end up firing about 70% of them
until you are left with the top 10 from that batch that you can keep long term

this is just how UGC works, usually most of the results from your UGC campaign will come from the top 20% of creators.

the other 20 are basically a waste of money. 
So we built a system to fix this.

I combined Claude + higgsfield mcp which is now thats generating us 100s of new realisitc UGC videos daily.

this allows us to test new formats for pennies on the dollar.
The whole thing runs without us touching it.

This is not theory, AI really is there now.

we have seen some  AI videos get as high as 
10k-50k+ views and have many comments asking whats the app.

Which proves that this converts.

( DISCLAIMER: always disclose that your videos are AI generated with a tag or somewhere on your post ) 99% won't notice the tag, but it's important to disclose to avoid any legal issues.

we have also spoken to multiple founders running this AI ugc playbook
with apps making over $100k/mo purely from AI content.

and the cost per video is basically < $0 for us, because we are sponsored by higgsfield haha, but for you it would be around a $29 or $39 subscription 

in this article ill break down our exact system to make Realistic AI UGC at scale.
#1 connect higgsfield MCP ( super easy )

This part is super simlple just go to higgsfield.ai/cli
send the command on your terminal or just send it to claude

and just like that you gave Claude a weapon of mass generation.
Claude can now generate world-class images and videos at scale.
#2 Research viral scripts

You cannot prompt your way to virality. 
You need data aka Viral formats in your niche that are proven to work.

Then and only then you can use claude + higgs to recreate them.

you can find plenty of viral formats by doom scrolling on your niche 

or inside of viewtrack.app we have a collection of over 4000+ 
viral formats you can take inspiration from.
#3 GENERATE THE CHARACTER ( Nano Banana Pro )

You can use the MCP for this but i prefer to do this in higgsfield UI first 
Then delegating video creation to the MCP 

To make your character its super simple
get clear on how you want your character to look

make sure to go for what works best in your niche
these things matter a lot to go viral

-> Age, ethnicity, hair, skin
-> Lighting (gym, golden hour, natural)
-> Environment (kitchen, gym, bedroom)
-> Accessories (resistance band, AirPods, water bottle)
-> Vibe (biohacker, wellness girlie, morning routine guy)

once you are clear on those variables
go to pinterest and literally look for someone who matches those characteristics

in this case let's say I want to use a guy that is in his car talking to the camera
I will use a pinterest image as a reference point

then get that picture and send it to higgsfield
 and make some edits to the character by prompting it.

to end up with a completely different look but in a realistic enviroment.

but having a starting image of a real person will ensure your final result also looks real which is the goal here. 

please be ethical and don't steal anyones identity. ( it's ilegal )
once you have that character down you are ready to mass produce videos
#4 THE CONTENT FACTORY

We are in the ERA of 24 hour software. With a claude max plan of $200/mo you are virtually unstoppable in what you can create.

Which is why I recommend to create your own website with your own workflow
and have claude + higgs MCP drop videos in there. 

think about it like this

> Claude is your executioner 
> Higgsfield is your artist 
> your workflow is what ties everything together.

In our case we made a custom website that stiches everthing togehter
higgs can also do this using their new feature Super computer.

but for our use case its a little different.

higgsfield generates four 15 second seedance videos which is the max length a seedance video can be.

then we have claude drop that video into our custom website and 

then the website stitches them together and automatically
edits them.

In summarythe complexity of automating this can vary depending on what format you are trying to replicate.

But ultimately everything can be done with enough prompting.

Then you can use @postbridge to schedule out the content to Tiktok, Youtube and Instagram right from the custom platform.

and thats literally it, now you have a content factory that can generate unlimited videos for unlimited characters

And post them across dozens of accounts.
IN SUMARRY

> connect your higgsfield MCP
> find a viral format to replicate
> create your character using nano banana in higgs
> have the MCP generate the video using your start image
> create your own custom website to scheduele out content and auto edit it
> generate 100s of new creatives per day and post them out
try this for your app and thank me later.

blocks.text: We have scaled our business to over $1M/yr with  projects across every space, B2C apps, SaaS and services.
And so far SaaS has been the hardest to crack by a mile.

With B2C apps the formula is pretty simple.
→ You get attention,
→ build a good onboarding,
→ add a strong paywall
→ and scale with creators or paid ads.

Services are also pretty straight forward.
→ You find a painful problem,
→ find the people with the proble
→ sell the outcome, 
→and fulfill the service.

But SaaS is different, because mostly you are selling to other founders
specially if your SAAS is X based

but we found a clear blueprint on how anyone can take their SaaS
from $0 to $10k MRR from doing it ourselves
1. Build software from your own pain

viewtrack.app came from a problem inside our own business
Most people start SaaS by asking the wrong question.

They ask “what SaaS should I build?” 

when the better question is what problem am I already dealing with every day that could be turned into software.
That is exactly how Viewtrack started.

We were scaling multiple apps with creators. 

UGC creators, influencers, faceless pages, organic content.
At first, it was manageable because we only had a few creators.

But once you start working with 10, 20, 30+ creators,
 the whole thing starts breaking.

so we said why don't we simply creator tracking from this:
to this:

And when you are running creator campaigns for apps, 
this is not a small problem.

This is directly tied to revenue.
 If they use the wrong CTA, you lose downloads.

If you don’t know which videos are working, you can’t scale.
So Viewtrack was not some random idea we pulled out of nowhere.

It was software we needed for ourselves.

The best SaaS ideas usually come from a problem 
you already understand deeply.

when you understand the pain, 

you know exactly what needs to be built.
2. Validate the pain before building too much

Once you find a problem, 
don’t disappear for 6 months building a giant product nobody will use.
That is how founders waste their life.

The goal is to find out if other people have the same problem
before you overbuild.
For Viewtrack, the validation was pretty obvious because we were already talking to founders, agencies and creators every day.

Everyone running UGC had some version of the same mess.
That is usually a good sign.

but for your SAAS you can validate on reddit or looking for the top people in your space and dming people in their comments.
Your job is to build a version that saves time and ultimately helps them make more money..
3. Build the smallest useful version

Your first version should not be huge. 
It should be useful.

most founders overbuild 
Which is literally why most of them make $0
For Viewtrack, the first version only needed to answer a few questions.

Who are the creators? 
What are they supposed to post?
When are they supposed to post? 
Did they post? 
How many views did they get? 
Which creators are actually worth keeping?

That’s the all we needed to solve for mvp 1.

Version 1 should be simple enough that you can send it out to a few people
and use it for it's core purpose.

for example this is viewtrack MVP1 vs how it looks now
4. HOW TO ACTUALLY GET SALES THROUGH X MARKETING

The most important part here is to not be a bot.
Most founders post on X like clankers.

 They say stuff like “just launched my new SaaS” 
or “excited to announce” literally nobody cares g.
You need a format that actually gets attention.
I’ve been doing X for about a year now, and the main reason it worked is because I shared my own experiences and real valuable information in my niche.

So now when I launched something like Viewtrack, 
people already know I’m not just saying random stuff.
They have seen me scale apps with creators before.
That’s why I think it’s ideal to build a SaaS around something you have already done yourself, which will help your X strategy

For Viewtrack, I started making posts that i knew would go super viral.
X loves free sauce. 

So instead of saying " go try viewtrack "

I gave away valuable information while displaying Viewtrack in action 
And that got me 500k views with just 1 post

then to convert i simply added a small CTA in the visual + in the text copy.

People click because the information is good,
and then they realize theres a product they can use behind it.

That is how you should market on X.
don't talk about your SAAS show your SAAS in action.

it may take some time, but consistency is key.
big accounts like mine with 50k+ followers 

also  started with 0 followers at some point
5. Prevent churn
Once you have a banger product and actually start getting sales, the most important part is preventing churn.
This is where SaaS gets annoying.
Because most users don’t churn because your product is trash.
A lot of the time they churn because they literally don’t understand how to use it.
Especially with a product like Viewtrack.
The product has a ton of different capabilities, so if someone signs up and gets overwhelmed, the easiest thing for them to do is just leave.
That is what we are trying to prevent.
This is where Poly is insane.
We use Poly to have a voice agent inside the product that users can talk to whenever they get confused.
The agent talks super clearly, just like a human, and it is trained on the whole platform.
So when a user clicks the little button, the agent can see their dashboard, understand what they are trying to do, and guide them through the exact question they have.
It’s literally like being on a call with a specialist.
Except you don’t need to hire a whole support team.
And hiring a support team for every confused user gets expensive fast.
With Poly, you can basically give every user instant help without adding a ton of overhead.
and thats an easy way to reduce churn by 30% to 50%
The $0 to $10k MRR blueprint

those are the 5 steps i would follow to build a world class $10k/mrr SAAS from scratch all over again. 

if you found this article useful!  feel free to follow me for more value.

blocks.text:
Last 2 weeks we generated 17M views with an army of 30 UGC creators
which is great, yet this posed a problem we had not thought about before.

running a team at this scale  is costing us over $6,000/week base,  but its working... our revenue nearly tripled in the last 2 weeks and our app is ranking #30 in the appstore.

last week it was more like $10,000 in spend between ads and our UGC team
which is normal when you mass hire. 

because 90% of our UGC campaigns success comes from the top 5-6 creators the rest are mostly noise.

These cost will obviously decrease as we fire the creators that are not performing and keep the killers.

but i encourage you to watch $10,000 leaving your bank account every week 
it really makes you ask yourself some questions. 

and for us that question was, how do we take our margins from 30% to 70%
and become extremely profitable?
and the answer to that question is the reason i'm writing this article.

We paid a guy $3.5k last week in bonuses 

and he told us that he was surprised we wanted to continue 
working with him.

He explained that most brands he works with fire him after he goes viral.

In my opinion thats either because their product sucks or because they have no money to sustain the cost. 

Thankfully we have a great app all around that helps us stay profitable nonetheless.

so while the average NGMI founder is stopping their UGC campaing
we are thinking how do we go beyond 30 creators 

How do we get 60 creators without having to double our weekly spend which would be $12,000/week 

and thats when we turned our eyes toward AI UGC

viral content is no more than 
Hook, script, face, delivery, post.  

its a system, a system that can skillfully be replicated with AI. 
and distributed at mass scale to create the same effect of Real UGC

at 1/10th of the cost, this is why I deeply believe AI ugc is the future.

we have already started to test AI ugc and it works 
with some of our videos getting up to 18k views.

and while thats not a lot, we literally just started, and nobody knows it's AI

AI ugc is not a theory, its all around us already.  
I've talked to the team from a looks maxing app  

they're doing over $30k/mo  running only AI UGC content.

I also talked to another 18yo kid who scaled his quit gooning app to $10k/mo with 1 single AI UGC creator.

there are plenty of examples so let me just list them a few out here:
These accounts alone together have generated over 300+ million views, but how do you actually build an AI UGC creator
What I learned from talking to a founder making $100k/mo with AI UGC
I wanted to see how the top killers in the AI UGC space were scaling

So I got on a call with a founder making $100k/mo with his app that he is scaling with AI UGC, he has been on starter story with verified metrics.

he gave me a super simple system

1.  you find a format that already works. 

find videos that already went viral in your niche.

For us, this is easy because our real UGC creators already 
showed us what works.

but you can find this by just scrolling on your niche.

so he basically takes the winning viral format, him and his team finds
and rebuild them with AI.

Then they break the video down.
Every viral UGC video is basically:
Hook → Script →Face → Delivery .

Once you see it that way, it stops being a video 
and becomes a recipe  that can be automated.
2. you build your AI UGC creator.
you can run the whole thing through Higgsfield Supercomputer.  so you give higgsfield supercomputer the winning format,  the creator and the prompt.

and It handles the rest.
Script, Video Editing, Final asset.

And the best part is once you get the AI video back if it looks good.
you can just tell higgs super computer  to create your 100s of variations 

And then again spread that across 5-10 influencers
And now you literally have an army.

I've already created 4 influencers for our app

3. Scale with clippers 

Once you have your AI ugc creators

you can basically hire US based clippers for $100 a month,literally, to just hit post on the videos that you give them, 

 ideally someone you know like you 14yo cousin with a scrolling addiction. 

since Higgsfield already edits the videos for you and makes them for you. 
you just give the clippers a google drive folder with the content to post

If you don't wanna fully automate it, it's fine to start just posting yourself. 

You can do up to 4 or 8  account in your own phone , and if you run out of space just buy a new iphone 8 for $250 and run up 8 more.

Shadow bans don't exist. 
and so now instead of paying $900/mo per creator 

you can pay  $30-$100/mo per realistic AI UGC creator that you make.

and thats literally all you have to do. 

I will keep using  this tech and keep you guys posted on how this continues to work for us.

be sure to follow for more daily sauce like this!
